Yoruba: Púpọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn Ethiopia ni wọn ń bá ikọ́ fée, HIV/AIDS, òtútù àyà, ìtọ̀ ṣúgà, jẹjẹrẹ àti ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru fínra.
Zulu: Iningi labantu base-Ethopia bayagula bathethwe isifo sofuba, HIV/AIDS isifo sokushisa kwamaphaphu, ushukela, umdlavuza, kanye nesifo sokunyuka komfutho wegazi.

Source: Unfortunately, medicines are often not available or are not taken properly by patients, and pharmaceutical services are generally poor.

Northern Sotho: Ka madimabe, dihlare ga se gantši di hwetšagala goba ga di nwewe ka tshwanelo ke balwetši, le gona ditirelo tša dikhemisi ga di kgotsofatše ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: እንዳለመታደል ሆኖ መድሃኒቶች ብዙ ጊዜ አይገኙም ወይም በታካሚዎች በትክክል አይወሰዱም፤ እንዲሁም የፋርማሲ አገልግሎቶች በአጠቃላይ ደካማ ናቸው፡፡

Source: The government wanted to improve the situation using a system called the “Auditable Pharmaceutical Transactions and Services” (APTS).
Luganda: Gavumenti yali eyagala kulongoosa mbeera okuyita mu muyungo oguyitibwa “Auditable Pharmaceutical Transactions and Services” (APTS).

Zulu: Uhulumeni ebefuna ukuthuthukisa isimo esebenzisa uhlelo olubizwa nge “Auditable Pharmaceutical Transactions and Services” (APTS).
Hausa: Gwamnati na son inganta lamarin ta hanyar amfani da tsarin da ake kira "Ma’amalolin Magunguna da Ayyuka Masu Bincikuwa" (APTS).
Northern Sotho: Mmušo o be o nyaka go kaonafatša seemo ka go šomiša lenaneo le le bitšwago “AuGo efoga mathata a, mmušo o amogetše molao go lenaneo le le bitšwago “Ditheransekšene tše di Lekolegago tša Famasithikhale le Ditirelo” (APTS).
Amharic: መንግስት ሁኔታውን ለማሻሻል የፈለገው “ኦዲት የሚደረጉ የፋርማሲ ግብይቶች እና አገልግሎቶች” (ኦ.ፋ.ግ.አ) የሚባለውን ስርአት በመጠቀም ነው፡፡

Source: In this 2017 study, researchers wanted to know if the system indeed improved medicine access for patients.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno okwakolebwa mu 2017, abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya oba nga ddala omuyungo gwatumbula obusobozi bw’abalwadde okufuna eddagala.
Yoruba: Ní iṣé. ìwádìí ọdún 2017, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ bóyá ètò náà mú ìdàgbàsókè bá àǹfààní àwọn aláìsàn sí oògùn.
Zulu: Kukolu cwaningo lezi-2017, abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi uhlelo lukwazile yini ngampela ukuthuthukisa ukutholakala kwemithi kwiziguli.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken na shekarar 2017, masu binciken sun so su sani idan tsarin ya inganta ingantaccen magani ga majiyyata.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše tša 2017, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge e ba lenaneo le tloga le kaonafaditše go hwetšwa ga dihlare ke balwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ የ2017 ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ስርአቱ ለታካሚዎች የመድሃኒት አቅርቦትን በእርግጥ አሻሽሎ እንደሆነ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They looked specifically at how the system was applied at 2 public hospitals in southern Ethiopia.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala baatunuulira engeri omuyungo gye gwakozesebwamu mu malwaliro ga gavumenti 2 mu bukiikaddyo bwa Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kanlẹ̀ wò bí ètò náà ṣe di lílò ní àwọn ilé ìwòsàn ìjọba 2 ní gúúsù Ethiopia.
Zulu: Babheka ngqo ukuthi loluhlelo lusetshenziswa kanjani ezibhedlela zikahulumeni ezi-2 eningizimu ye-Ethopia.

Northern Sotho: Ba be ba lebeletše kudu ka moo lenaneo le bego le dirišwa go dipetlele tše 2 tša mmušo ka borwa bja Ethiopia.
Amharic: በተለይ በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ በሚገኙ 2 የመንግስት ሆስፒታሎች ስርአቱ እንዴት እንደሚተገበር ተመልክተዋል፡፡

Source: They surveyed pharmacy staff and interviewed 400 patients.
Luganda: Baanoonyereza ku bakozi b’omu malwaliro agagaba eddagala era ne babuuza abalwadde 400.

Zulu: Bahlola abasebenzi base khemisi base befaka imibuzo iziguli ezingama-400.
Hausa: Sun binciki ma'aikatan kantin sayar da magani kuma sun tattauna da majiyyata guda 400.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile diphatišišo ka bašomedi ba khemisi le go swara dipoledišano le balwetši ba 400.
Amharic: የፋርማሲ ሰራተኞችን ዳስሰዋል፤ እንዲሁም ለ400 ታካሚዎች ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል፡፡

Source: They used statistical methods to analyse their answers so that they could draw conclusions about any differences between the 2 hospitals.
Luganda: Baakozesa obukodyo bw’ebibalo okusengejja ebyanukulo byabwe okusobola okukola okukubira ku njawulo zonna eziriwo mu malwaliro 2.

Zulu: Basebenzise indlela yezibalo ukuhlaziya izimpendulo zabo ukuze bezofinyelela eziphethweni ngmehluko phakathi kwezibhedlela ezi-2.

Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše mekgwa ya dipalopalo go sekasela dikarabo tša bona gore ba kgone go fihlelela diphetho mabapi le diphapano magareng ga dipetlele tše 2.

Source: Unfortunately, they determined that the ATPS system was of a low quality at both hospitals.
Luganda: Ekyomukisa omubi, baazuula ng’omuyungo gwa ATPS gwalina omutindo gwa wansi mu malwaliro gombi.

Source: They said patients showed little knowledge of medications, medication was expensive, and patients did not have access to all medications needed.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abalwadde baalaga nga balina okumanya kutono ku ddagala, eddagala lyali lya bbeeyi, ate era ng’abalwadde tebaalina busobozi obufuna eddagala lyonna lye baali beetaaga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní òye ìmọ̀ oògùn kékeré ni àwọn aláìsàn fi hàn, iye owó oògùn wọ́n, àwọn aláìsàn kò sì ní àǹfààní sí gbogbo àwọn oògùn tí wọ́n nìlò.
Zulu: Bathe iziguli ziveze ulwazi oluncane ngemithi, imithi ibibiza, iziguli zazingakwazi ukuthola imithi edingakalayo.

Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore balwetši ba laeditše tsebo ye nnyane ya dihlare, dihlare di be di bitša tšhelete ye ntši, le gore balwetši ba be ba kgone go hwetša dihlare ka moka tše di hlokegago.

Source: There was also pharmaceutical mismanagement, and resources, staff, and facilities required for dispensing medications were not satisfactory.
Luganda: Enzirukanya y’amalwaliro nayo yali mbi, ng’ebikozesebwa, abakozi, n’ebintu ebyetaagibwa mu kugaba eddagala nabyo byali tebimatiza.
Yoruba: Àimójútó ìṣẹ́ ìpoògùn tún wà, àwọn ohun èlò, òṣìṣẹ́ àti àwọn èròjà tí ó nílò fún pínpín oògùn kò tẹ́ni lọ́rùn.

Hausa: Akwai kuma rashin sarrafa magunguna da albarkatun da ma'aikata, kuma wuraren da ake buƙata don rarraba magunguna ba su gamsar ba.

Source: Most Ethiopians live below the poverty line, so having access to affordable medicines is key to making healthcare accessible and equitable to citizens.

Zulu: Iningi lase-Ethopia lihlala ngaphansi kwendlala, ngakhoke ukukwazi ukuthola imithi abakhonayo ukuyikhokhela kubalulekile ekwenzeni ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kufinyelele futhi kulingane kwizakhamuzi.

Northern Sotho: Bontši bja badudi ba Ethiopia ba be ba phela bodiiding, ka gona go hwetša dihlare tša theko ya fase go bohlokwa go dira gore tlhokomelo ya maphelo e fihlelelwe le go ba ya tekatekano go badudi.

Source: Researchers say this study shows which challenges hospitals need to address to improve access, and they recommend administrative training for those who dispense medicines.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dinyakišišo tše di bontšha ditlhohlo tšeo dipetlele di swanetšego go di rarolla go kaonafatša phihlelelo, gomme ba šišinya gore bašomedi bao ba fanago ka dihlare ba hwetše tlhahlo ya tshepedišo.
